title: After a Rejection
selection_rationale: High candidate pain, likely to stop the scroll.
Creates an open loop that earns the next few seconds.

heygen_settings.captions: burned-in for TikTok/Reels, sidecar optional for archive

spoken_script: A rejection is data. It is not your identity. Turn rejection into a better next application without spiralling. First: Log where you dropped out: CV, test, interview, final round. Second: Change one controllable thing before the next attempt. Third: Keep a rejection-safe pipeline so one no does not stop everything. The rule is simple: Separate signal from story: log what happened, adjust one thing, keep moving. Keep going. Search your next opportunity at internwise.co.uk

production_notes: Open with direct eye contact and no intro logo.
Keep cuts every 2-4 seconds using zooms, captions, or B-roll cards.
Use the first on-screen text line as the thumbnail/title frame.
Do not say 'link in bio' in the video. Put it only in IG/TikTok captions if needed.
No em dashes in captions or overlays.
